answer: Locks are published in copper, expire in ripple, and inlet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 130 aliases therefore needs 93 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4922 identities would post 2151 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
